source.title: The quantization of probability distributions: some results and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document ID 5070477. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/5070477 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403 in the local fetch path, so the zbMATH API was used only as resolver metadata.

zbMATH API metadata identified the exact work as Siegfried Graf, "The quantization of probability distributions: some results and open problems", Real Analysis Exchange Summer Symposium 2002, pages 87-102, identifier 1103.94013. The API record exposed no full-text links and its review/summary text was unavailable due to licensing.

Bounded exact-work recovery inspected exact-title and identifier searches. Dialnet listed the article in Real analysis exchange, 2002, Vol. 26, No. 26, pages 87-102, but only as an issue/article listing with no readable article body. The University of Passau publication page confirmed the conference-proceedings entry but provided no linked full text. Academia.edu appeared in search results for the exact title, but the readable search/open path did not expose article text or a confirmed downloadable artifact. AMS and dissertation/PDF candidates only cited the work in bibliographies or discussed related later work and were rejected as different sources or metadata-only.

Failure mode: metadata_only with blocked_or_challenged resolver access. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered within the bounded recovery pass, so no questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, snippets, or related papers.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/5070477.json and outputs/latest.json.
